units.healys-v6-alpaca-orders.service:
# /home/healy/.config/systemd/user/healys-v6-alpaca-orders.service
[Unit]
Description=V6 isolated Alpaca paper orders
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/home/healy/Coding/HealysBacktester
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1
Environment=MPLCONFIGDIR=/home/healy/Coding/HealysV6/nn_meta/live/v6_alpaca_paper/matplotlib
ExecStart="/home/healy/Coding/HealysBacktester/venv/bin/python" "-m" "scripts.run_v6_alpaca_runtime_v5" "poll" "--state" "/home/healy/Coding/HealysV6/nn_meta/live/v6_alpaca_paper"
TimeoutStartSec=45
MemoryHigh=1G
MemoryMax=1G
MemorySwapMax=0
Nice=5
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true

# /home/healy/.config/systemd/user/healys-v6-alpaca-orders.service.d/99-ten-minute-v6.conf
